locations.name: The Abandoned Wharf
locations.sensory: Cold fog rolling over splintered boards; the smell of brine and diesel.
locations.description: Old fishing boats rot along the docks. Locals whisper about lights flickering beneath the waves.

locations.name: Northline Railway Tunnels
locations.sensory: Dripping water echoing through endless concrete; distant metallic clanks.
locations.description: A decommissioned transit line now sealed from the public. Something still moves deep inside.

locations.name: The Hollow Pines Motel
locations.sensory: Buzzing neon; moldy carpet; televisions that switch on by themselves.
locations.description: A decaying roadside motel where guests often check in but rarely stay the night.

locations.name: Ward & Latch Funeral Home
locations.sensory: Soft organ hum; cold marble; faint scent of wilted flowers.
locations.description: Recently shut down after rumors of strange activity during embalming hours.

locations.name: Red Harbor Chemical Plant
locations.sensory: Sour chemical stink; echoing pipes; dripping pink runoff.
locations.description: An old industrial plant abandoned after a mysterious accident. Security has been removed, but locals avoid the place.

locations.name: Ashmoor Library Basement
locations.sensory: Dusty tomes; cold air drafts; the quiet rustle of unseen pages.
locations.description: The library’s basement archives hold documents that no one claims responsibility for.

locations.name: The Broken Observatory
locations.sensory: Crunching shattered glass; owl calls; warped metal groaning in the wind.
locations.description: Once used for meteorological research. Now a ruin surrounded by inexplicable electromagnetic events.

locations.name: Penance Hill Cemetery
locations.sensory: Wet soil; rustling dead leaves; distant bells.
locations.description: A sprawling hillside cemetery where fresh graves sometimes appear overnight.

locations.name: Southmoor Police Station – Evidence Wing
locations.sensory: Flickering fluorescent lights; stale coffee; locked cabinets rattling by themselves.
locations.description: Files have gone missing recently. Officers refuse to discuss the matter.

locations.name: The Lantern Street Market (After Hours)
locations.sensory: Scattered trash blowing in the wind; stray cats; metallic echoes.
locations.description: An open-air bazaar during the day, but after midnight strange vendors appear with impossible wares.
